billing.title: After the trial
billing.body: Choose and purchase a monthly plan separately for each workspace (Company) you want to keep using. Trial expiry does not trigger a charge.
billing.renewal: Once purchased, a subscription renews monthly under the subscription terms.

faq.title: Questions about pricing and billing
faq.q1: When does the trial start, and can I get another?
faq.a1: No card is required. The 21-day trial begins after your first eligible completed business setup and is available once per payer. A new workspace does not restart it.
faq.q2: What happens when the trial ends?
faq.a2: Choose and purchase SOLO or STUDIO for each workspace you want to keep using. There is no automatic charge. Without a subscription or another valid source of access, work is restricted; trial expiry itself does not delete your data.
faq.q3: Who counts toward the service-professional limit?
faq.a3: Anyone actively providing services, including a working owner, even without a login. An administrator who does not provide services does not count, but their access requires STUDIO.
faq.q4: Can I choose SOLO after the trial?
faq.a4: Yes. First keep one active service professional, revoke additional team access and cancel pending team invitations. People are not deleted automatically.
faq.a5: Once purchased, your subscription renews monthly. Final currency, applicable taxes and terms are shown before payment.
